chapter: What You Would Feel (second minute — careful second / magnetar / stack)
carry: Teaspoon grammar: when VO names a thing, that thing is the picture.
Mute test. Physics-led, not gore. At most ONE Orbit+distant-remnant hang — magnetar plate only.
Neutron star = compact GLOWING remnant (locked Parts 01/04/05 look). Never a grey moon, never Death Star greebles, never clay.
No stacked ellipses, oval billboards, halo discs, or vertical clip walls.
No cartoon mouths. One face, two arms, one centered underside glow. Exactly one Orbit.
SPIN LOCK: at most one gentle bank in the minute. No corkscrew / orbit-around-the-remnant on every plate.

plates.vo_idea: A second a careful distance away? You might live — watching in awe, taking notes, feeling nothing but wonder.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. SHIP GATE OPEN: a compact GLOWING NEUTRON STAR / remnant FILLS the frame. Photoreal celestial sphere, locked remnant look. ZERO Orbit, ZERO robot, ZERO title. HARD FORBIDDEN: Orbit, any robot, grey moon, Death Star greebles, cracked-city plates, clay, title card. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: A second near the surface? You are not a person anymore. You are a brief geometry problem.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. Orbit is ALREADY in frame on the left, HOLDING STATION beside the compact glowing remnant on the right — gyroscope hover, 1cm drift only. Face the remnant the whole clip. Nose toward the star. Camera HOLDS; slow push-in only. HARD MOTION LOCK: do NOT bank into frame, do NOT fly around the remnant, do NOT corkscrew, do NOT tumble, do NOT spin, do NOT orbit the star, do NOT circle the pair. One visor FACEPLATE, TWO arms, cream eyes with pupils, ONE centered underside glow. HARD FORBIDDEN: spin around the star, corkscrew, amateur orbit-around-star, grey moon, lunar craters, Death Star greebles, honeycomb panels, circuit-board crust, clay grey wall, unfinished placeholder, two Orbits, two faces, cartoon mouth, flame jet. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: Orbit tries a thought experiment: hover with perfect thrusters at a safe radius.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. Orbit HOLDS STATION — hovering with a single centered BOTTOM underside glow, gyroscope hover-pad, not twin jets. Thought-experiment hover. One visor FACEPLATE, TWO arms, cream eyes with pupils. He banks slightly to keep position. HARD FORBIDDEN: twin thrusters, flame plumes, cartoon mouth, two faces, two Orbits, remnant hang, grey moon, knockoff. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: Even then, radiation and magnetic fields may cook systems gravity hasn’t shredded yet.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. HARD RADIATION / X-ray storm rakes across Orbit from the right — he FLINCHES, systems cooking. Photoreal high-energy light, not a grey planet. One visor FACEPLATE, TWO arms. HARD FORBIDDEN: cartoon mouth, two faces, two Orbits, four arms, flame jet, grey moon, Death Star greebles, knockoff. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: Magnetars — neutron stars with monstrous magnetic fields — can distort electron clouds in atoms at distances where the star still looks small in the sky.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. MAGNETAR: a TINY compact glowing remnant still looks SMALL in the far sky while monstrous magnetic fields twist through the vacuum around Orbit. Photoreal star, not a grey moon. This is the one distant-star hang. Orbit BANKS through the field. One visor FACEPLATE, TWO arms. HARD FORBIDDEN: huge nearby sun, grey moon, Death Star greebles, oval galaxy sprites, cartoon mouth, two faces, two Orbits, four arms, knockoff. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: can distort electron clouds in atoms
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. ELECTRON CLOUDS around atoms DISTORT under a monstrous magnetic field — photoreal luminous plasma sheets shearing in vacuum. NOT a neon logo, NOT a Bohr-model textbook diagram, NOT a screensaver. NO Orbit. NO readable letters, NO HUD. HARD FORBIDDEN: Orbit, text, oval galaxy sprites, grey moon, Death Star greebles, flat discs as planets. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: So the body doesn’t meet one danger. It meets a stack: tides, radiation, magnetism, and finally a surface that refuses to be a floor.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. A STACK of dangers layers through the frame — tidal shear, radiation wash, magnetic twist. Orbit is caught in the stack, bracing. Photoreal physics, not a grey moon floor. One visor FACEPLATE, TWO arms. NO readable labels, NO HUD. HARD FORBIDDEN: cartoon mouth, two faces, two Orbits, four arms, grey moon, Death Star greebles, knockoff. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: and finally a surface that refuses to be a floor.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. A compact GLOWING STAR / neutron-star remnant FILLS the frame and INTENSIFIES — boiling photosphere, corona, fierce light. LOOKS LIKE A STAR, not a planet you can stand on. ZERO Orbit. plates.vo_idea: What happens next if you keep closing anyway?
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. Orbit ABORT-THRUSTS AWAY from a compact GLOWING STAR remnant — one centered BOTTOM underside glow flares as he pulls up and leaves. Nose along the escape. He flies AWAY, never into a hole. Documentary, not a load screen. Exactly ONE Orbit. One visor FACEPLATE, TWO arms. HARD FORBIDDEN: portal, wormhole, white wireframe, geometric tunnel, flying INTO a hole, two Orbits, cracked-city crust, yellow street-grid cracks, honeycomb plates, dark rocky planet, grey moon, landing legs, cartoon mouth, twin thrusters.
